bio.text: Doug Basler, a Republican, advanced from the August 2026 open primary for Washington's 9th Congressional District and will face Democratic incumbent Adam Smith in the November general election.
JNS describes him as a former senior vice chairman of the King County Republican Party and current vice president of the Eastside Republican Club.

sources.title: ‘Excited district is recognizing need to reject job-killing socialism,” Basler tells JNS, after advancing in Wash. state’s 9th - Israel & Jewish News - JNS
